items.title: Faster DB graph scans
items.summary: Cut several O(graph) paths in views, journals, refs, and startup revision checks so larger graphs stay responsive.

items.title: Snappier block editing
items.summary: Stopped re-rendering the editor box on every keystroke and sized the textarea with CSS field-sizing where supported.

items.title: More reliable DB worker
items.summary: Moved lock ownership to SQLite and keep the worker healthy across system sleep so graphs do not get stuck after idle.

items.title: Library and sidebar polish
items.summary: Hide library blocks, collapse nested pages more cleanly, and refresh favorites after drag-and-drop reorder.

items.title: Property paste and undo fixes
items.summary: Copy and paste text property values as blocks, restore property values after undo, and keep child page content on selection delete.

items.title: Query and table view fixes
items.summary: Fixed query result views and set-literal editing, restored property columns, and sped up DB table scrolling.

items.title: CLI and Windows build fixes
items.summary: Added force-remove page, username/password login, and fixed Windows vite/bundle and state-phase build issues.

items.title: Import and publishing fixes
items.summary: Convert markdown headings into DB heading metadata on import, and honor default home in HTML export.

items.title: Faster file-graph import
items.summary: Optimized the file graph import path and preserved mention timestamps, icons, and PDF annotations more reliably.

items.title: Page rename and delete edge cases
items.summary: Update linking page mirrors on rename, tag Recycle as Page so File→DB deletes work, and load breadcrumbs on demand.

items.title: Property and shortcut polish
items.summary: URL property editor UX, default Task status icons, shared default shortcuts when resetting, and Contents from the right-sidebar menu.
